name: leadlens
description: LeadLens: a TL's lens for reviewing code, architecture and implementation. Weekly and monthly engineering reports from GitHub commits, PRs, reviews and issues, a fast pre-merge review pass (guidelines, UI/UX, accessibility, defensive security), a Lead Lens audit of one change with real gates and a ship verdict, a full-repository audit of one author's commits across every branch, and a hook that blocks hardcoded secrets.
